Slovak Accounting Localization — full suite

Installs the Slovak statutory localization in one step, offers the optional pieces as switches in the settings, and cross-checks the VAT filings with each other and with the ledger.

Version19.0.1.4.3
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresl10n_sk, l10n_cssk_core, l10n_sk_statutory, l10n_sk_kv_dph, l10n_sk_ec_sales, l10n_sk_vat_return, l10n_sk_invoice, l10n_cssk_partner_balances, l10n_cssk_vies, l10n_cssk_accrual, l10n_sk_inventory_verification
Extended byl10n_sk_dppo_fs

What it is for

The Slovak localization is split into many modules so that each company installs only what it needs. This module is the one-click way in: installing it brings the statutory core for a Slovak company and adds switches for the optional parts. It also adds three cross-checks between the VAT filings and the ledger.

What it installs

Area Module
Shared core: settings, tax offices, filing life cycle l10n_cssk_core
Slovak statutory base l10n_sk_statutory
VAT return (daňové priznanie k DPH) l10n_sk_vat_return
Control statement (kontrolný výkaz DPH) l10n_sk_kv_dph
EC sales list (súhrnný výkaz) l10n_sk_ec_sales
Slovak invoice layout l10n_sk_invoice
Partner balances and offsetting (saldokonto, zápočet) l10n_cssk_partner_balances
VIES check of EU VAT numbers l10n_cssk_vies
Accruals (dohadné položky) l10n_cssk_accrual

Each of these modules has its own guide.

Optional pieces

Accounting → Configuration → Settings, block Czech / Slovak Localization. Tick a switch and save: Odoo installs the module. Unticking it uninstalls the module again.

Switch (Slovak label) Installs Notes
Synchronizácia kurzov (NBS/ECB) currency_rate_update_sk daily NBS/ECB rates and bank rates; Community only
Časové rozlíšenie l10n_sk_account_cutoff prepaid and deferred expenses and revenues (381–385); Community only
Kontrola spoľahlivosti dodávateľa l10n_sk_payment_reliability checks the supplier's registered bank account before you pay
Dvojité odpisovanie l10n_sk_account_asset_tax tax depreciation alongside accounting depreciation
Spôsob A evidencie zásob l10n_sk_stock_account_method_a perpetual inventory accounting (spôsob A); delivered in a separate repository

Účtovné vzory (interné doklady) l10n_sk_account_move_template named debit/credit templates for internal documents
Účtovná závierka l10n_sk_fiscal_year_closing year-end closing through 710 / 702 and opening through 701
Finančný prenájom l10n_sk_account_loan_oca finance lease

Vozidlá a PHL l10n_sk_vehicle_expense vehicles and fuel
Manažérske výkazy l10n_sk_mis_reports management P&L on MIS Builder; not a statutory statement

Daňové priznanie DPPO l10n_sk_dppo corporate income-tax return

With both the financial statements and the income-tax return installed, l10n_sk_dppo_fs installs itself and ties the accounting result to the tax return.

On Odoo Enterprise the exchange-rate and deferral switches are hidden, because Enterprise has its own.

Cross-checks between filings

Three buttons appear on the filing forms once a filing has been computed (state other than draft). Each one creates or refreshes a comparison on the Filed vs computed screens described in l10n_cssk_core, with the result per row and room for the accountant's answer.

On the form of Button Compares
Control statement (KV DPH) Porovnať s priznaním the KV with the VAT return of the same period
EC sales list Porovnať s priznaním the EC sales list with the VAT return of the same period
VAT return Porovnať s účtovníctvom the VAT return with account 343 and account class 60

The VAT return used is a computed or exported one of the same company whose period overlaps — an exact period match first. If there is none, the button says so; compute the return first.

KV and VAT return. The control statement never contains all of the return — sales to non-taxable persons, simplified invoices and similar supplies are on the return only — so the KV must be contained in the return, not equal to it:

Block KV sections Return rows
Output VAT A.1 + C.1 r. 02 + 02a + 04
Self-assessed VAT B.1 r. 06, 06a, 08, 10, 10a, 10b, 12, 12a – 12e
Deducted VAT B.2 + B.3.1 + B.3.2 + C.2 r. 18 + 18a + 19

A smaller KV figure is shown as Difference is expected. A larger KV figure is impossible and is reported as a difference, with a hint to check the classification of the supplies.

EC sales list and VAT return. Goods supplied to another member state (transaction code 0) must equal row 14. Triangular trade (code 1) and services (code 2) have no row of their own in the return and are not compared.

VAT return and ledger.

Row Compared with Result
Output VAT, r. 17 VAT booked on sales taxes in the period difference if they do not agree
Deducted VAT, r. 18 + 18a + 19 VAT booked on purchase taxes in the period difference if they do not agree
Taxable base, r. 01 + 01a + 03 + 13 credit turnover of account class 60 always informational

The base and the revenue legitimately differ (advance payments, accruals, acquisitions, financial income), so that row is never a finding.

A tolerance of € 0.50 or 0.1 % of the compared amount, whichever is larger, applies everywhere.

Limitations

  • The cross-checks are advisory. They do not block exporting or filing.
  • The KV check assumes full deduction; with a coefficient (koeficient) the deducted VAT blocks will not agree.
  • The ledger check splits VAT into output and input by the tax's type (sale or purchase). Under domestic reverse charge, where one invoice carries both, the split is approximate.
  • A switch for a module that is not on the server (Method A, the financial statements, the income-tax return) does nothing.
  • Uninstalling this module does not uninstall what it brought in.
  • The setting help for Spôsob A evidencie zásob says perpetual inventory is required for audited companies; this guide does not confirm that statement.
